article.title: Claude Opus 4.5將於2027年1月22日從API退役
article.title_en: Claude Opus 4.5 is scheduled to retire from the API on January 22, 2027
article.summary: Anthropic在11月23日發出Opus 4.5棄用通知，建議Claude API用戶在2027年1月22日退役前遷移至Opus 5.5。
article.summary_en: Anthropic issued an Opus 4.5 deprecation notice on November 23, recommending migration before its scheduled API retirement.
highlights: 日期版與無日期版Opus 4.5模型編號均包括在內，目前並非立即停用。
模型退役後請求會失敗；合作夥伴營運的平台可能採用不同時間表。
highlights_en: Both dated and undated Opus 4.5 IDs are covered; the notice is not an immediate shutdown.
Requests to retired models fail, while partner-operated platforms may follow different schedules.
article.why: 仍以Opus 4.5產出內容或分析報表的團隊，需要把模型遷移納入交付安排，避免既有自動流程在退役後中斷。
article.why_en: Teams using Opus 4.5 for content or reporting need to schedule migration before existing automated deliveries stop working.
article.next_step: 請技術負責人列出兩個Opus 4.5編號的使用位置，按平台時間表安排替換，並用既有品牌格式及標準答案做回歸檢查。
article.next_step_en: Locate both Opus 4.5 IDs, confirm the serving platform's schedule and test replacements against established brand formats and known answers.
article.detail: 棄用表示模型仍可運作，已不再建議作新部署；退役則代表無法繼續請求。官方模型表列明日期，並提供使用量匯出方法，協助按API金鑰及模型找出依賴。行銷團隊可把準時交付、欄位格式及既有內容規則列成遷移驗收項目，逐一比較替換結果，而非只確認新模型能回覆。
article.detail_en: Deprecated models still function, whereas retired models cannot serve requests. Anthropic documents usage exports by API key and model to locate dependencies. Marketing teams can define delivery, field-format and content-rule checks for migration rather than treating a successful response from the replacement as sufficient.
article.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
